preamble: Debuccalization of a rhotic to the glottal stop [ʔ]. In Egyptian the coda r of words like ḥr 'face' was lost and replaced by a glottal stop, as reconstructed for Classical Coptic /hoʔ/. The Kuki-Chin cases go through an intermediate velar stop and belong in r_to_k and k_to_glottal_stop.

examples.note: The final r was lost and a glottal stop remains in the reconstructed Coptic pronunciation.
